versions.changelog:
- Removed the sample file skill-card.md from the project.
- No changes made to core functionality or documentation (SKILL.md remains unchanged).
- This update is a cleanup of non-essential files only.

- Initial release of the 图像提取转换服务 (Image Extraction & Conversion Service) skill.
- Provides extraction and conversion of images from local files, URLs, or base64 data to base64 format for LLM analysis.
- Requires user-provided API key for all operations; prompts user if key is not set.
- Includes tool functions for extracting images from file paths, URLs, or base64 data.
- Ensures parameter completeness by prompting the user for missing input as needed.
- Images are automatically resized to optimal dimensions (max 512x512) for analysis.
